title: Unsigned LEB128 varints
summary: Encode 1,000 unsigned 64-bit integers as concatenated unsigned LEB128 varints and decode them back, one value per call of the package.
notes: Inputs are decimal strings, because JSON numbers lose precision above 2^53; every adapter parses them into unsigned 64-bit integers in prepare, before any timing. Every adapter runs the same two loops (encode each value and append, then decode from offset 0 to the end), so the figure is 1,000 encodes and 1,000 decodes plus the loop.
